{{Quote|And ''Ahsoka Tano'' has become the new ''champion'' of the sector!|A [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] announcer on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]|<ref name="The Masked Racer">{{SWComicCite|7.3|The Masked Racer}}</ref>}}
The '''Dustig sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Drez Unlin]] was the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] champion of the sector, until [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Mission to Malastare (Anakin Skywalker)|defeated]] him in a single lap podrace on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and became the new champion.<ref name="Labyrinth">{{SWComicCite|7.2|Labyrinth (comic story)}}</ref>
